_about: Hello Padel court outlines for the stats steps, in pixels of the camera picture scaled to 1920x852 (cameras give 4256x1888). poly = where a player's feet can be; court = left sideline slope,offset, right sideline slope,offset (x = slope*y + offset), far edge y, bottom of the picture y, net y. Fitted by eye on camera stills 2026-11-22 20:01 and drawn back on them to check.
